```{r}
#Functions
sqrt(9)
round(3.14159)
```
```{r}
#Arguments
round(3.14159, digits = 2)

#Ordering Arguments
print(seq(1, 10, 2))
print(seq(by = 2, from = 1, to = 10))

print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(x=5, times=7))
```
```{r}
#Variables
my_variable <- 12
my_variable <- 10
print(my_variable)

#Numeric Variables
x <- 4e-3
print(x)

#Character/String Variables
x <- "I am a variable"
print(x)

#Logical/Boolean Variables
x <- TRUE
print(x)
x <- FALSE
print(x)

#Classifying Variables
x <- "hi there"
print(class(x))
x <- 1513871
print(class(x))
x <- FALSE
print(class(x))

#Exercise
number <- 7
print(number)
word <- "hello"
print(word)
true_or_false <- TRUE
print(true_or_false)

print(class(number))
print(class(word))
print(class(true_or_false))
```
